nodes.label: ReadPanda Primary Logo (Panda Reading Under Blanket)
Cozy Night Reading Brand Identity
nodes.rationale: The current brand mark depicts a panda reading an illuminated open book under a blanket against a near-black backdrop, with the warm glow of the page as the only light source. The visual argument is that ReadPanda is for intimate, low-light, late-night reading rather than daytime study: it justifies the app's dark reader chrome and warm accent color, and it reads well at small icon sizes because the glowing book keeps a bright focal point on a dark field. This supersedes an earlier light/pastel kawaii direction (flat white panda face on white, green bamboo splash), which signaled a playful children's app and washed out against dark reader surfaces.
